m.aarti.tek: Om, victory to you who delight the world; Mother, victory to you, root of all bliss. Revā, you are Brahmā, Hari, Hara and Śaṅkara; you are Śiva, Hari, Śaṅkara and Rudrāṇī, the one who sustains.
m.aarti.pad1: Devī, you grant boons to Nārada and Śāradā; you are ever new, holding the rank of Caṇḍī. Gods, men and sages serve you; gods, men, sages and Śāradā worship your feet.
m.aarti.pad2: Devī, you ride your mount in splendour, playing the vīṇā; swaying, swaying, swaying, with a jingling, jingling sound, you sport and shine.
m.aarti.pad3: Devī, cymbals and the mṛdaṅga play, and you delight in the svaramaṇḍala; to tān after tān in Toḍī, to the turaṛaṛ, turaṛaṛ, turaṛaṛ of the instruments, you delight, full of melody.
m.aarti.pad4: Devī, you are enthroned over all the worlds, joyful day and night. Gaṅgā and Śiva sing of you; Revā, Śiva serves you; you wipe away worldly existence.
m.aarti.pad5: A golden plate is set for Mother, with agarwood, camphor and a wick. You dwell at Amarakaṇṭaka; on ghāṭ after ghāṭ shines the light of ten million jewels.
m.aarti.pad6: Those who read and sing Mother's āratī day and night — Revā, men sing it age after age, and Svāmī Śivānanda sings it in worship — repeating Hari's name, gain the fruit their hearts desire.
